## Walkthrough The change adds two new test case identifiers to the InformingTests collection for EVPN BGP scenarios with randomly generated VTEPs, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 network configurations. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Test Case Additions**
